# GitHub Repository SEO Configuration

This file documents the recommended GitHub repository settings for maximum discoverability.

## Repository Topics (Add these on GitHub)

Go to your repository → About (⚙️ settings) → Add topics:

```
react
react-hooks
react-context
context-selector
performance
optimization
typescript
context-api
hooks
use-context
redux-selector
re-render
state-management
frontend
```

**How to add:**
1. Go to https://github.com/HussnainQuresshi/use-context-hook
2. Click ⚙️ (gear icon) next to "About" on the right sidebar
3. Add topics from the list above
4. Add description: "Prevent React Context re-renders with Redux-style selectors. TypeScript support, tiny bundle size."
5. Check ✅ "Releases" and ✅ "Packages" if you publish releases
6. Save changes

## Repository Description

**Current:** (probably empty or generic)

**Set to:**
```
Prevent React Context re-renders with Redux-style selectors. TypeScript support, tiny bundle size, zero dependencies.
```

## Website URL

Set to: `https://www.npmjs.com/package/use-context-hook`

## Why This Matters

- GitHub topics are indexed by Google
- Good description appears in search results
- Topics help developers discover your library
- GitHub's internal search ranks better with topics
- npm, GitHub, and Google all index these keywords
